description: This entity restricts products by the occupation code. This can make the product available to these occupation codes or make it unavailable for these occupation codes.

name: PRODUCT_OFFER
description: A mapping of which PRODUCTs are involved in a specific OFFER. name: PRODUCT_PACKAGE_FEATURE
description: This entity associates a marketable product that is part of a specific product package with a feature. A product that is part of a package can have many features and the feature can apply to many products that are part of packages. There is one instance for each product-feature association.

name: PRODUCT_PACKAGE_FEATURE_LEEWAY
description: This entity contains the leeway that a job function has when negotiating a product that is part of a package.

name: PRODUCT_PACKAGE_FEATURE_RELATED
description: This associative entity allows for a feature-to-feature relationship on the level on product package.

name: PRODUCT_PACKAGE_TYPE
description: Classifies this product as a package (group of products as the offering) or an individual product as the offering.

name: PRODUCT_PAYMENT_OPTION
description: This entity identifies the payment options that are available for this product. For example, if the account/product is a credit card, then the type of payment could be minimum or full. name: PRODUCT_PROFIT
description: This entity tracks the product's profit amount over time. This is a derivable result and technically should not be in a logical model. It is included here if the cost and revenue components in the model are not populated.

name: PRODUCT_RELATED
description: This associative entity relates products to other products. There is one instance for each relationship. name: PRODUCT_REVENUE
description: This entity identifies the revenue for a product for a time period. Types of revenue include revenue not allocated to accounts and transactions such as resale of loans to secondary market. This is a component in calculating profitability.

name: PRODUCT_REVIEW_EVENT
description: This entity captures information specific to product review events.

name: PRODUCT_RISK_GRADE
description: This entity contains risk grade assigned to product for a certain period of time.  For example, if the product offering is a home mortgage 30-year fixed interest then this is the risk grade associated with that offering.

name: PRODUCT_RISK_GRADE_RELATED

name: PRODUCT_SCORE
description: This entity contains the result of predictive modeling at the product level.

name: PRODUCT_SCORE_MODEL_ELIGIBILITY
description: This entity restricts products by score model values. This can make the product available to these score values or make it unavailable for these score values.

name: PRODUCT_STATUS
description: This entity contains the history of the status of the product.

name: PRODUCT_STATUS_TYPE
description: This is a code for the life cycle of this product.  Examples: - Not yet a product - Active product - Inactive/discontinued product

name: PRODUCT_STRUCTURE_TYPE
description: This code entity identifies the point of view structure that this relationship between products represents. name: PRODUCT_TAX_STATUS
description: Product tax status based on country and state such as taxable or not taxable.

name: PRODUCT_TO_PRODUCT_GROUP

name: PROJECT_TASK_RESOURCE_PRODUCT
description: This entity lists groups of fixed assets related to a PROJECT TASK.

name: PROMOTED_PRODUCT_EVENT
description: This entity captures information regarding the selection of a promoted product by the visitors.

name: PROMOTION_PRODUCT_OFFER
description: This entity contains information about promotion offers that are directed towards a product.

name: PROMOTION_PRODUCT_OFFER_FEATURE
description: This entity contains the features that are offered as part of this product promotion offer.

name: PROPOSAL_FEATURE
description: Terms and conditions for this proposal that are independent of any product or service.

name: PROPOSAL_PRODUCT
description: The products or services being proposed.

name: PROPOSAL_PRODUCT_FEATURE
description: The product features, terms, and conditions that are being proposed.

name: RATE_FEATURE
description: This is a subtype entity to FEATURE. It consists of interest rates, fee rates, and other rates.

description: A classification for the type of rate such as fixed interest rate, variable interest rate, or other rate (e.g., insurance coverage).
